service.description: The endpoints, models and feature bindings in effect: the llm-facade conf with the LlmEndpoint, LlmModel and LlmFeatureBinding rows over it (a row's fields replace the conf's by id). Keys are masked. Each entry says where it came from (source: conf, database, or conf and database); a model says whether it can take a call (usable: yes, or why not) and a binding which model it resolves to. problemList names the conf entries and rows that did not read.
One small call to a model (modelId, or the first model of endpointId), recorded as an LlmCall with source test.

Tiny live requests for each capability (tools, parallel-tools, json-schema, streaming, reasoning-replay, prompt-caching), each verdict stored in LlmModelCapability with its evidence. An admin's verdict is kept.
An admin's verdict on a capability of a model (yes, no or partial), which no probe replaces; an empty verdict removes the stored one, so the next probe decides.

Recompute the LlmUsageDaily rows of usageDate, or of today and the days before it, from LlmCall: a day's rows are replaced whole, each day in its own transaction, and a day that fails does not stop the others. The job rollup_LlmUsage runs it every 15 minutes.

parameter.name: days
parameter.description: With no usageDate, the days before today

service.description: Clear the request and response content of the calls older than retentionDays (default the llm-facade content-log retention-days). The job clean_LlmCallContent_daily runs it.

Whether a user (default the current one; another user's needs AgentAdmin) may make more calls in a scope (all, agent, gateway, api): the user's LlmQuota row, else the largest of their groups', else the llm-facade limits, against today's calls (and the month's for a monthly quota).

The request and response JSON of an LlmCall (kept only with content logging, redacted): for the call's own user, or for a user with AgentAudit, whose read is written to AgentAuditLog. Anyone else gets no content (contentShown false, with the reason).

parameter.name: reason
parameter.description: Why an auditor reads it, for the audit log

service.description: For System > LLM > Dashboard: the calls, tokens and cost of today (from LlmCall) and of this month (the rollup of its earlier days and today) over all users, as maps with callCount, errorCount, inputTokens, cachedInputTokens, outputTokens, totalTokens, cost and currencyUomId; and the runs submitted today, waiting for input or authorization, and failed today.

For System > LLM > PromptPreview: the frozen prefix an agent's new conversation would get on a surface and prompt variant for a user (agentId, default assist; surface, default the agent's first; variant, default the model's; userId, default the current user), and the tail of a sample page: each section with its characters, calibrated tokens, cap and share of the model's budget, the tools with their schema sizes, the system text, the tail, and the request as the model's protocol would send it with a sample message (requestJson, "copy as sent"). The model is modelId, else the agent's feature or tier. The user's memory is shown only for the viewer's own user. Nothing is stored.

parameter.name: surface
parameter.description: drawer, chat, a2a, mcp, job or tui

parameter.name: samplePath
parameter.description: The page of the sample tail

parameter.name: catalogList
parameter.description: The catalog entries (name, description, kind) of a conversation started on the sample page; System > LLM > Skills > RetrievalTest shows the scores

parameter.name: catalogMore
parameter.description: The skills past the catalog's lines

service.description: Create or change a tool exposure (System > LLM > Tools): a service offered to the agents as a tool of the lazy catalog. lockVersion is the version the editor read: a row changed since then is not saved (the editor reloads it), and each save moves it on, so a run that asked for an approval of the old version notices. The tool name is checked (not a prefix kept for MCP and A2A tools), the service must be defined, and the classification, preview mode and schema override must read. Out: the new lockVersion and the classification the service has of its own.

parameter.name: lockVersion
parameter.description: The version read; empty for a new row

service.description: For System > LLM > Skills: sync the skill files (skill/**/*.md of the framework and each component, in load order) into AgentSkill rows now, as startup does. Each file is its own transaction; a file that does not read, or names a skill an earlier file named, is a problem naming the file and the others go on; a row whose file is gone is retired. Needs AgentAdmin.

Create or change a skill from its Markdown with front matter (skillText): a site skill (needs AgentAdmin) or, with personal=Y, the caller's own personal skill (AgentUse), which shadows the site skill of its name unless that one is locked. A skill from a file takes only locked (its text is the file's); a site skill of a file's name needs overrides: name in its front matter. One site skill a name, one personal skill a name for each owner. A front matter error is the message, naming what is wrong. Out: the skill and its version.

parameter.name: personal
parameter.description: Y for a personal skill of the caller (a new skill only)

service.description: For System > LLM > Skills > SkillDetail: a skill's Markdown with its front matter as an editor shows it, its sections (name#slug, title, purpose, size), the risk that counts (only a skill a person wrote lowers one), whether it comes from a file, and the id of the skill in effect for its name (for its owner when personal, else for the site): another one when this one is shadowed or overridden. Needs AgentAdmin.

For System > LLM > Lessons: approve a lesson for every user (statusId AglApproved), reject a proposed one or withdraw an approved one (AglRejected). A lesson is its author's alone until approved, and shows only with a skill load or a screen answer on its anchor, as untrusted text. Needs AgentAdmin.

For System > LLM > Skills > RetrievalTest: the skills a query finds for a user (default the caller, with their personal skills), agent (default assist) and surface (default drawer), best first, each with its score (the lexical score, or the fused one when an embedder is installed), the semantic cosine, whether it is a strong match and what matched; the answer the skill tool gives to find with the query; the tail line a later message would carry; and the catalog a conversation that starts with the query on page lists. Needs AgentAdmin.

parameter.name: page
parameter.description: The page path, a retrieval boost for skills that name it

service.description: For System > LLM > Conversations, Runs and Approvals: the content of a conversation (its transcript, messageList, and its runs), a run (stepList; toolCallList with arguments and results; eventList with payloads; approvalList) or an approval (with its arguments, snapshot, changes and edited arguments). Shown (shown true) for the content's own user, or for a user with AgentAudit, whose every read is logged in AgentAuditLog with the reason; for anyone else only the runs, steps and the tool calls' names and statuses come back, with the reason why. AgentAdmin alone does not show another user's content (D12).

parameter.name: reason
parameter.description: Why the auditor reads it, for the log

service.description: Stop any user's run (System > LLM > Runs), as the user's own Stop does: the partial answer is kept. It stops the run and acts for no one. Needs AgentAdmin.

Create or change a client of the A2A server, the MCP server or the LLM gateway (System > LLM > Gateway; docs/Gateway.md). Its credential is an app password of its user (appPasswordId) or one of the user's login keys (loginKey: the key itself, kept only as its hash and never shown again); a new client needs one. Refused: a user that does not exist, a credential that is not the user's, a scope that is not a2a, mcp or gateway, and a second client with the gateway scope for the same credential. A field left out keeps its value. Needs AgentAdmin.
